niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, contemporary interfaces with strong hierarchy, clear structure, and a finished feel. They consistently like screens that feel intentional and well-composed: visible context, layered depth, clear CTAs, coherent grouping, and refined spacing. They often respond positively to either airy light minimalism or moody dark drama depending on task, but in both cases they want strong contrast, expressive accents, modern rounded shapes, and interfaces that feel distinctive rather than generic or unfinished.

criteria.description: Prefers interfaces with emphatic hierarchy: prominent titles, clearly separated title/body/action levels, and obvious focal points rather than flat or evenly weighted layouts.
Prefers populated, production-ready screens with visible content, fuller category coverage, and a complete-feeling structure rather than sparse, empty, or prototype-like layouts.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated sections, grouped rows/cards, and systematic structure that improves scanability and makes the interface feel orderly.
Prefers strong, clearly foregrounded primary CTAs with assertive color and emphasis, especially when the action should feel obvious or urgent.
Prefers interfaces that preserve surrounding screen context and use layered composition or modal depth, rather than isolating content on obscured or contextless backgrounds.
Prefers visually refined, balanced, contemporary UI with polished proportions, cohesive detailing, and a distinctive non-template feel.
Prefers interfaces with vivid or nuanced accent color, multicolor/pastel icon treatments, and stronger personality over monochrome or muted generic styling.
Prefers softer, more contemporary rounded or pill-shaped buttons and controls over boxier, standard rounded-rectangle treatments.
Prefers clearly defined components—distinct cards, rows, inputs, and separations—so elements feel crisp, legible, and purposefully delineated.
